It extends the DTP facility for certain employees to employers in the tourism sector (pariwisata) with specific KLU codes listed in Lampiran A. For these employers the facility covers Masa Pajak October–December 2025. It also adds rules allowing refunds of excess withholding to permanent employees of tourism employers, limited to the part not borne by government. This changes a facility, its eligibility and its validity period for PPh 21 on permanent employees.
